label: Dobutamine
summary: Inotrope acting mainly on beta-1 receptors. It raises contractility and heart rate, and can lower blood pressure through mild beta-2 vasodilation.

levers.why: Beta-1 stimulation also speeds the heart rate.
More work per beat and per minute raises myocardial oxygen demand.

nursingPriorities: Watch for tachycardia, new arrhythmias and hypotension; dobutamine does not raise BP by itself.
Expect it to be paired with a vasopressor when MAP is low, per orders.
